intro: Latvians love ice hockey and basketball, and the small country has celebrated some big upsets.

chapters.title: Ice hockey
text: When Latvia won its first ever medal at the ice hockey world championship, bronze in 2023, the government declared a public holiday the next day.

chapters.title: Basketball and tennis
text: Latvia won Olympic gold in 3x3 basketball in 2021, and Kristaps Porziņģis is an NBA star. Jeļena Ostapenko won the French Open in 2017 while unseeded.

keyTerms.meaning: A fast version of basketball with three players a side and one hoop.
